# Reviewed exceptions to the applied-migration rule. One entry per line:
#   <migration file name>@<40-hex git blob sha>
# An entry lets exactly that file differ from its first applied version, and
# only while its content is exactly that blob (`git rev-parse <ref>:<path>`).
# Any later edit fails the guard again.
#
# The guard reads this file from the base ref (or origin/develop when the base
# predates the guard), never from the pull request, so a pull request cannot
# grant itself an exception. Adding a line needs its own pull request with the
# founder's approve-migration review (D-041) and a reason here.
#
# 20261001000000_scribe_hardening.sql: commit 3730551 (2 Oct 2026) changed the
# file to match what was actually applied to the live database, and moved the
# unapplied policy change to 20261002010000_entries_select_policy.sql. Findings
# register CI-02. Reviewed 3 Oct 2026.
20261001000000_scribe_hardening.sql@fab49f91bb9341bf5bebeed0a47286336e56b836
